claims.claim: Native return polarity is inverted in conceptual pseudocode
claims.native_evidence: 6F4A94 initializes ESI=1; absent resource reaches 6F4BCF and returns EAX=ESI. Normal parse success sets ESI=0.
claims.repair: Represent zero-success/nonzero-failure native status. Do not use false to represent missing-file return without an explicit inversion wrapper.

claims.claim: Pseudocode advances the callback result instead of the original Shout node
claims.native_evidence: ESI retains original node; virtual +14 result is EAX; next iteration reads [ESI+40]. Null callback result skips append.
claims.repair: Maintain original-node iterator separately from converted callback result and preserve null-result branch.

claims.claim: Final signed tree inequality is reversed
claims.native_evidence: 843901 cmp esi,[edx+C]; 843904 jl sentinel. ESI is search key. Lower-bound best >= key; absent key5 with candidate7 must return sentinel.
claims.repair: Return head if best==head or key<best.key. Preserve signed comparison and calling convention.
